name: glua-gmod
description: Language server for Garry's Mod Lua — AST-based IntelliSense, realm awareness, hook and net message analysis, cross-file diagnostics.

commands.title: GLua: Treat This File As GLua
GLua: Treat This File As Plain Lua

markdownEnumDescriptions: Take over `.lua` files only in workspaces that look like Garry's Mod addons or gamemodes.
Take over every `.lua` file. Use this if detection misses your layout.
Never take over `.lua` files. Only `.glua` files are handled.
glua.activation.markdownDescription: Controls when `.lua` files are treated as GLua instead of plain Lua. `auto` keeps this extension out of the way of Love2D, Luau, Neovim and other Lua projects.

glua.workspace.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of Lua files to index in a workspace.

glua.workspace.exclude.description: Glob patterns excluded from workspace indexing.

glua.workspace.libraries.markdownDescription:
Source trees for frameworks this project uses but does not contain — ULib, DarkRP, Wiremod. Each is indexed for what it defines, so its globals stop reading as undefined and its functions gain real signatures, and none of it is ever reported on.

Paths may be absolute or relative to the workspace, e.g. `../ulib` or `C:/servers/mine/garrysmod/addons/ulib`.

This reads the framework's own source rather than a bundled list of names, so it is exact and cannot fall out of date.

glua.workspace.gamePath.markdownDescription: Path to a Garry's Mod directory, e.g. `C:/Program Files (x86)/Steam/steamapps/common/GarrysMod`. Asset paths complete from your own `materials/`, `models/` and `sound/` folders without this, but are only reported as missing when it is set — a material can come from the base game, and guessing without it would be wrong far more often than right.

glua.diagnostics.undefinedGlobal.description: Reading a global that is neither a known GMod API member nor assigned anywhere in the workspace.

glua.diagnostics.realmViolation.markdownDescription: Calling a serverside-only function from a clientside file, or vice versa. The function is nil in that realm, so the call fails at runtime.

glua.diagnostics.unusedLocal.description: Locals that are declared but never read.

glua.diagnostics.deprecated.description: Use of API members the wiki marks as deprecated.

glua.diagnostics.argumentCount.description: Calling a known API function with too few or too many arguments.

glua.diagnostics.argumentType.description: Passing an argument whose inferred type cannot match the documented parameter type.

glua.diagnostics.missingAsset.markdownDescription:
A material, model or sound path that does not exist. Missing content never raises a Lua error — it renders as the checkerboard, the error model, or silence.

Requires `#glua.workspace.gamePath#`, and **off by default on purpose**: only turn it on if every asset you reference ships in this repository. Content mounted from the Workshop or a separate content pack is invisible from here, so on a typical server most findings would be wrong.

glua.diagnostics.unknownHook.markdownDescription: `hook.Add` with a name that is neither a documented hook nor called by `hook.Run`/`hook.Call` anywhere in the workspace. Catches typos like `"PlayerSpawned"`.

glua.diagnostics.netMessage.markdownDescription: `net.Start` on a message never passed to `util.AddNetworkString`, and `net.Receive` for a message never sent.

glua.diagnostics.netReadWriteMismatch.markdownDescription: The sequence of `net.Write*` calls in a `net.Start` block does not match the `net.Read*` calls in the matching `net.Receive`.

glua.diagnostics.missingAddCSLuaFile.markdownDescription: A clientside file that is never passed to `AddCSLuaFile`, so it will never reach clients.

glua.diagnostics.duplicateIdentifier.markdownDescription: Two `hook.Add` calls sharing an event and identifier, or two `timer.Create` calls sharing a name, in overlapping realms. The second silently replaces the first.

glua.diagnostics.perfHotPath.markdownDescription:
Expensive work reached from something the engine runs every frame or tick — a render hook, `ENT:Think`, a `timer.Create` that repeats forever at 0.5s or less. The call is reported where it is written, with the chain of functions that reaches it.

Calls behind a guard that plainly limits how often they run — a `CurTime()` comparison, a `nextThink` field, a one-time `if not x then` gate wrapping a block — are left alone. A validity check like `if not IsValid(ent) then return end` is not one of those, and neither is a guard around the registration rather than the callback.

glua.diagnostics.unusedFunction.markdownDescription:
Functions this workspace defines and never calls, references or registers anywhere.

**Off by default**: a library meant to be used by other addons is full of these on purpose, and nothing here can see the addon that calls them. Turn it on for a self-contained gamemode, where the workspace really is the whole program. `glua doctor` lists them either way.

glua.diagnostics.unusedSuppression.markdownDescription:
A `-- glua-ignore` or `-- glua-disable` comment that never silenced anything.

A suppression outlives the finding it was written for: the code gets fixed, the comment stays, and from then on it silently covers whatever appears on that line next. A misspelled rule name looks identical to working protection.

Only reported for files that parse, since a parse error stops most rules from running and every directive in the file would read as dead.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Only report problems in files you have open.
Report problems in every indexed file, so cross-file issues show up without opening anything.
glua.diagnostics.scope.markdownDescription: How much of the workspace to report problems for. `workspace` costs one extra pass over every file after indexing.

glua.diagnostics.globalWrite.description: Writing to a global instead of declaring a local. Noisy by design; off unless you want it.

glua.inlayHints.parameterNames.description: Show parameter names inline at call sites of known API functions.

glua.inlayHints.realm.description: Show the inferred realm at the top of each file.

glua.completion.callSnippets.description: Insert parentheses and tab stops for parameters when completing a function.

glua.completion.filterByRealm.description: Hide API members that cannot exist in the current file's realm.

glua.hover.wikiLinks.description: Include a link to the Garry's Mod wiki in hover documentation.

glua.format.enable.markdownDescription: Enable the GLua formatter. Select it per language with `editor.defaultFormatter`.

glua.format.maxLineWidth.description: Column to wrap tables and argument lists at.

glua.format.quoteStyle.description: Preferred string quotes. Strings are only rewritten when it needs no extra escaping.

glua.format.operatorStyle.markdownDescription: What to do with GLua's C-style operator aliases.

glua.format.commentStyle.markdownDescription: Whether to rewrite `//` and `/* */` comments as `--` and `--[[ ]]`.

glua.format.spaceInsideParens.markdownDescription: Write `func( a, b )` instead of `func(a, b)`. This is the style used across the Garry's Mod wiki.

glua.format.keepSingleLineBlocks.markdownDescription: Keep blocks the author wrote on one line on one line, e.g. `if not IsValid(ent) then return end`.

glua.format.maxBlankLines.description: Consecutive blank lines to keep between statements.

glua.format.semicolons.description: Whether to keep optional trailing semicolons.

glua.trace.server.description: Trace communication with the language server.
